sections.title: When custom AI development is the right investment
sections.description: Custom AI is not always the answer. We recommend it when it produces an advantage a packaged tool cannot.

blocks.heading: Custom AI makes sense when
paragraphs: Your competitive advantage depends on proprietary data, workflows or domain knowledge that a generic SaaS tool cannot use. The AI must integrate deeply with internal systems. Data residency, privacy or regulatory requirements rule out third-party processing. Or usage volume is high enough that owning the system costs less over time than per-seat or per-call SaaS pricing.

blocks.heading: An off-the-shelf tool is usually better when
paragraphs: The problem is common across industries (generic meeting notes, basic email drafting), the workflow does not touch sensitive data, and a mature product already meets your accuracy requirements. In those cases we will tell you so during discovery.

blocks.heading: What you own at the end
paragraphs: Source code, trained model weights, data pipelines, evaluation datasets, infrastructure-as-code and documentation. There is no licensing lock-in — your team or any vendor can operate and extend the system after handover.

items.question: What is custom AI development?
items.answer: Custom AI development is designing, training and deploying AI systems built specifically for one organization's data, workflows and goals — as opposed to licensing a general-purpose AI product. It can include custom machine learning models, LLM applications, computer vision systems, AI agents and the integrations that connect them to existing software.

items.question: How much does custom AI development cost?
items.answer: Focused single-use-case systems typically start around $20,000. Custom ML models usually run $30,000–$100,000, computer vision $40,000–$200,000, and multi-system enterprise platforms more. ClickMasters quotes a fixed price after discovery.

items.question: How long does a custom AI project take?
items.answer: Most focused projects launch in 6–20 weeks. Complex computer vision, agent or platform projects can take 20–40 weeks. Discovery typically takes 1–3 weeks.

items.question: Do we need a lot of data to build custom AI?
items.answer: It depends on the approach. LLM applications with retrieval can work with your existing documents and little or no labeled data. Custom ML and computer vision models usually need historical or labeled examples — we assess data readiness during discovery and can help with labeling or synthetic data when data is limited.

items.question: Who owns the AI system after delivery?
items.answer: You do. ClickMasters transfers full IP — source code, model weights, pipelines, evaluation datasets and documentation — at project completion.

items.question: Can custom AI integrate with our existing systems?
items.answer: Yes. Integration is part of every engagement — ERP, CRM, data warehouses, document stores, helpdesks and internal tools via APIs, webhooks, ETL or, where necessary, legacy-system connectors.

sections.heading: Scope your custom AI system with a senior engineer
sections.text: Tell us about the problem you want AI to solve. Within one business day you will hear from an engineer — not a salesperson — with initial thoughts on feasibility, approach and budget range.
